rows.behavior: The write-docs skill exists in the plugin with one reference file per Diataxis type.
rows.fails_when: plugin/skills/write-docs/SKILL.md is missing or any of the four reference files is missing

rows.behavior: The skill creates pages only through kmctl new doc and writes only the prose.
rows.fails_when: SKILL.md tells the agent to create a page file, folder or index entry itself instead of running kmctl new doc

rows.behavior: The skill was made with skill-creator and its test prompts are kept beside it, covering one request of each Diataxis type.
rows.fails_when: no test prompts are kept, fewer than four types are covered, or the skill-creator run's results show a request filed in the wrong folder
